items.title: Meta’s deal to keep Zuckerberg in California adds fuel to wealth tax debate ahead of election
items.description: With less than two weeks before the midterm elections, Meta made clear that Mark Zuckerberg is staying in California if the wealth tax passes.

items.title: Lawsuit accuses Trump of illegally profiting off foreign crypto deals
items.description: "We're suing to stop the corruption and to force President Trump to return the profits to American taxpayers," attorney Matt Pelikan told CNBC.

items.title: SpaceX and Tesla have high election stakes as Elon Musk pours $366 million into campaigns
items.description: Musk’s biggest political bet is on the Senate, where control could shape future investigations, federal spending and regulations affecting SpaceX and Tesla.

items.title: Moderna shares plunge after cancer vaccine data leaks — despite positive results
items.description: Moderna released full data on its closely watched cancer vaccine developed with Merck.

items.title: Trump asked Musk to lift Starlink slowdown, WSJ reports
items.description: Elon Musk, a critic of Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, had ordered the slowdown of SpaceX's Starlink, The Wall Street Journal previously reported.

items.title: Disney’s multiplatform Super Bowl plan frustrates ABC affiliates
items.description: Disney is airing the Super Bowl on ABC, ESPN, Disney+, ESPN2, ESPNU, and NFL Network, to the chagrin of local station affiliates.

items.title: OpenAI nears up to $30 billion funding round at $1.25 trillion valuation led by UAE investors
items.description: OpenAI is close to finalizing a new funding round that is meant to be a bridge to its 2027 IPO, sources familiar with the matter tell CNBC.

items.title: Trump defends Ramaswamy ad with Acton's estranged mom after bipartisan criticism
items.description: Ohio Gov. Mike DeWine said GOP gubernatorial nominee Vivek Ramaswamy should remove the ad featuring the mother of Democratic nominee Amy Acton.

items.title: CoreWeave’s market confidence erodes as bond yields spike and stock sinks
items.description: CoreWeave shares are down 36% in October, and the spreads in its credit default swaps are widening.

items.title: A lesson from poker tells us not to fold on Meta after its earnings sell-off. Here’s why
items.description: Meta's in-house AI lab is not getting enough credit on Wall Street.

items.title: Reported fraud losses among older Americans hit $3 billion in 2025 as big losses surge: FTC report
items.description: Older Americans reported $2.1 billion in fraud losses of at least $100,000, accounting for 70% of the $3 billion lost overall, according to the FTC.

items.title: Brent crude tops $113, highest level since May, after Trump hints at action on Iran
items.description: The Middle East conflict could flare up again as the U.S. reportedly plans to resume strikes against Iran.

items.title: Musk's clash with Ukraine accelerates demand for Starlink alternatives. Few exist
items.description: Governments or companies looking for an alternative to SpaceX's Starlink are faced with few options, as Amazon, Eutelsat and others are far behind.

items.title: Pepsi renews contract with Taco Bell days after KFC switches to Coke in the U.S.
items.description: Taco Bell is sticking with longtime beverage supplier PepsiCo, even though sister chain KFC defected to Coca-Cola.

items.title: Virginia state Sen. L. Louise Lucas, a Trump critic, charged in marijuana racketeering case
items.description: The investigation into the Democrat predates the current Trump administration. But the timing of the indictment before the midterms has raised eyebrows.

items.title: AI debt and French bonds face a stress test — why it may not be over
items.description: Bond markets are signaling unease over AI financing costs and sovereign debt in parts of Europe. More stress tests are coming.

items.title: Bill Ackman says 2027 will be an amazing year for stocks as wars, inflation ease
items.description: "We're going to have an amazing 2027," he said.

items.title: Third-party evaluators found vulnerabilities in OpenAI monitoring system during test pilot
items.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman pledged to grant independent evaluators "employee-like access" to the company to help address mounting safety concerns.

items.title: FIFA launches tender of 2030 men's World Cup U.S. media rights, plans to choose winner by end of year
items.description: FIFA is formally auctioning its U.S. media rights and wants bids by Nov. 19.

items.title: Judge orders Trump to sit for deposition in BBC defamation lawsuit by Dec. 11: Reports
items.description: Trump's lawyers had requested that his deposition be conducted between Jan. 11 and Jan. 22.
